book.name: Galatians
book.title: Galatians Paul Ana Fef Galatia Isah

content: Ofafar O Baitumatum
Kwa Galasia sabuw i kwabikoko’aw! Yait rarafi kwabi’afesair? Kwa etei matamaim Jesu Keriso onaf afe’en momorob isan, ayu bebeyan maiyow ana morob mi’itube i akubunabuna kwanowar.
Imih au baibat ta’imon anibat kwanao ana nowar. Anun Kakafiyin kwabaib i ofafar eo na’atube kwasisinaf imih kwabai, o Tur Gewasin kwanowar kwaitumatum imih kwabai?
Kwa mi’itube’emih kwabikoko’aw! Kwa i Anun Kakafiyinamaim kwabusuruf; naatu boun i kwakokok taiyuw a fairamaim kwanakusouwimih kwabiwa’an?
Kwa iti biyababan kwabai kwabi’akir kwanotanot i yabin en ai ana yasisir en? Ige, iti sawar ibo anayabin auman o ana’an auman.
God Anun Kakafiyin ebit naatu wanawanamaim ina’inan ebiwa’an, anayabin ofafar eo na’atube kwasisinaf imih ebit o Tur Gewasin kwanowar kwabitumatum imih ebit?
Abraham ana yawas mi’itube ma’am i kwana’itin; Buk eo na’atube, Abraham God itumitum, naatu i ana baitumatumamaim God bai, anayabin ana ef mutufurin God matanamaim.
Imih kwa i kwanaso’ob, Abraham wawawan anababatun i sabuw iyab aurih baitumatum ema’am.
Buk marasika eo baiman na’atube, God Ufun Sabuw baitumatumamaim boro nayamutufurih. Naatu imih Tur Gewasin Abraham isan eorereb. “O wanawanamaim God boro sabuw etei nigegewasinih.”
Abraham itumatum naatu baigegewasin bai, imih sabuw iyab tibitumatum i baigegewasin tebaib i baib na’atube.

Sabuw iyab ofafar tafan hitumatum hima tibi’ufunun, nati sabuw i o rarafen babanamaim tema’am. Anayabin Bukamaim eo, “Orot yait Ofafar Bukamaim hikirum inu’in mar etei men nati tur eo na’atube ebi’ufunun, nati orot i God ana orarafen babanamaim ema’am!”

Imih boun i bebeyan ebi’obaiyit men yait ta ofafar eo’omaim boro ana ef nayamutufur nan God biyan natitamih. Anayabin Bukamaim eo, “Orot yait baitumatumamaim ana ef yamutufur na God baib, i akisinamo boro nama.”
Ofafar ana bowabow i men ta baitumatumamaim ema’am, baise Bukamaim eo, “Orot yait sawar etei ofafar eo na’atube nasisinaf na’at boro nama.”
Baise it etei ofafar ana orarafen babanamaim tama’am Keriso tubunit it ata orarafen i bai; anayabin Bukamaim eo, “Orot yait ai afe’en teo’onaf nati orot i God ana orarafen ebaib.”
Keriso iti sinaf saise baigegewasin God Abraham eo’omatan i Keriso Jesu’umaim tan Ufun Sabuw hitab, saise baitumatumamaim Anun Kakafiyin tatab God eo’omatanit na’atube.
Ofafar Naatu Omatanen
Taitu tuwai’inah, ayu i boro mar etei tasisinafumaim ao kwana’itin. Orot rou’ab sawar ta isan hairi hio hibasit wabih obaibasit ana fefemaim hikikirum boro men yait ta na’astu’ub o tafan naya’abar.

Naatu boun kwana’itin, God ana omatanen ta Abraham eomatan, naatu uwan auman eomatan, Bukamaim i men hikirum hio wawawan, nati i men wanawan moumurih isah eo, baise uwan ta’imon isan eo. Nati uwan i Keriso.

Abisa ao anayabin i God Abraham hairi obaibasit ta hikirum in, imaibo kwamur 430 sasawar ufunamaim ofafar matar, imih men karam God ana obaibasit marasika kikirum boro ta’astu’ub naatu ana omatanen tabosair.
Anayabin God ana siwar ofafar tafanamaim tabatabat na’at, nati i ana omatanen tafanamaim boro men tabat, baise God ana bosiyasiyaramaim ana omatanen kaif Abraham baigegewasin itin.

Imih ofafar ana’an i abisa isan matar? Ofafar mamatar ana’an i kakafih imaim itinin so’ob isan. Naatu imaim tabonawiyit tanan Abraham uwan isan God eo’omatan tan tatit. Iti ofafar i tounamatar hibai hire orot foun batayan hitin.
Naatu God Abraham omatanen bitin ana veya i men foun batayan orot biyanamaim sinaf, baise God akisin foun bat sinaf.
Ofafar Anayabin
Kwanotanot ofafar naatu God ana omatanen hairi i tibigamigam? En anababatun, anayabin ofafaramaim orot ana yawas tabaib na’at, turobe orot ana ef yamutufurin isan boro ofafaramaim tan.
Baise Bukamaim eorereb tanowar, tafaram tutufin etei i bowabow kakafin ana fair bai karatan. Imih ef ta’imon God ana omatanen bain nowatamih matar isan i Jesu Keriso akisinamo tanitumitum.
Baitumatum i ufibo natit, baise wantoro’ot i ofafar buwit ana dibur yariyit tama nan imaibo baitumatum natit irerereb.
Isan imih ofafar i ata bai’obaiyen orot na’atube bonawiyit tana Keriso biyan tatit, naatu boun i baitumatumamaim ata ef yamutufur God nanamaim tatit.
Imih it boro men ofafar ana bonawiyenamaim tanama’amih, nati i sawar, anayabin boun i baitumatum ana veya tit.
Naatu kwa etei’imak baitumatumamaim kwana Jesu Keriso bairi kwaita’imon God natunatun kwamatar.
Keriso wabinamaim bapataito kwabai ata kou’ay ta’imon matar, imih Keriso ana yawas a faifuwamih kwa’us.
Imih kwa i men a itinin tata’amih, men Jew o Ufun Sabuw, men akir o roufamen sabuw, men orot o babin, kwa etei i ta’imon Keriso Jesu ana baita’imonin wanawananamaim kwama’am.
Keriso kwa nowa namamatar na’at, kwa i Abraham wawawan naatu God abisa eo’omatan boro kwanab.
